schemes.objective: To supplement the financial needs of Small and Marginal farmers in procuring various inputs to ensure proper crop health and appropriate yields, commensurate with the anticipated farm income at the end of each crop cycle
benefits: Direct income support of Rs. 6,000 per year in three equal installments of Rs. 2,000 each
Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to Aadhaar linked bank accounts
Financial support for agricultural and allied activities
Protection from falling into clutches of money lenders
eligibility_criteria: All land-holding farmer families (husband, wife and minor children under 18 years)
Own cultivable land in their names irrespective of size of land holdings
Names entered into land records (excluding institutional landholders)
Cut-off date for land holding determination: February 1, 2019
Mandatory e-KYC verification
exclusions: Farmer families with members holding constitutional posts
Government employees (except Multi Tasking Staff, Class IV, Group D)
Income tax payers in last assessment year
how_to_apply: Visit official PM-KISAN portal: https://pmkisan.gov.in
Click on 'New Farmer Registration' in Farmer's Corner
Provide Aadhaar number, bank account details, land records
Submit required documents and complete e-KYC
Track application status online

schemes.objective: To provide insurance coverage and financial support to farmers in case of crop loss due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases while encouraging farmers to adopt innovative and modern agricultural practices
benefits: Comprehensive risk insurance for crop losses
Low premium rates: 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi crops
Coverage from sowing to harvesting
Post-harvest losses coverage (up to 2 weeks)
Prevented sowing/planting risk coverage up to 25% of Sum Insured
Localized risk coverage (hailstorm, landslide, inundation)
Mid-season adversity coverage for widespread calamities
eligibility_criteria: All farmers (loanee and non-loanee) including sharecroppers and tenant farmers
Growing notified crops in notified areas
Valid land ownership certificate or land tenure agreement
Application within 2 weeks of sowing season start
Valid Kisan Credit Card (KCC) or obtain within 6 months of enrollment
Valid bank account and identity proof
Insurable interest for notified/insured crops
exclusions: Losses due to war, nuclear risks, riots
Grazing/destruction by livestock and wild animals
Preventable losses due to farmer negligence
how_to_apply: Visit official PMFBY portal: https://pmfby.gov.in
Click on 'Farmer Corner' and select 'Guest Farmer' if new user
Enter required details and create account
Fill application form with crop and land details
Submit through Agriculture Department, Common Service Center, or online
Pay premium amount and receive policy documents

schemes.objective: To assess soil health status and provide crop-wise recommendations of nutrients and fertilizers required for better soil health and higher crop yields while promoting judicious use of fertilizers
benefits: Free soil testing every 3 years
Detailed soil health report with 12 parameters
Crop-specific nutrient recommendations
Fertilizer use optimization guidance
Reduction in input costs through balanced fertilization
Improved soil fertility and crop productivity
Promotion of organic farming practices
eligibility_criteria: All farmers across the country
Land-holding farmers (small, marginal, medium, large)
Sharecroppers and tenant farmers (with valid agreements)
Cooperative societies and farmer groups
No restriction on land size or crop type
exclusions: No specific exclusions - universal coverage intended
how_to_apply: Visit Soil Health Card portal: https://soilhealth.dac.gov.in
Contact local Agriculture Extension Officer
Submit soil samples at designated collection centers
Provide land details and farmer information
Collect soil health card from village center or download online

schemes.objective: To create a unified national market for agricultural commodities by networking existing APMC markets through online trading platform for transparent price discovery and efficient marketing
benefits: Transparent online trading with enhanced market accessibility
Real-time price discovery based on demand and supply
Reduced transaction costs for buyers and sellers
Online payment directly to farmers' bank accounts
Quality certification and assaying facilities
Access to broader market beyond geographical boundaries
SMS updates on commodity prices and sales
Mobile app for market information access
eligibility_criteria: All farmers, traders, buyers, processors and exporters
Valid license for traders (single license valid across state)
Registration on e-NAM portal
Bank account linked with Aadhaar
Quality testing facilities in participating mandis
State APMC Act reforms compliance
exclusions: Markets not integrated with e-NAM platform
how_to_apply: Visit e-NAM portal: https://enam.gov.in
Register as farmer/trader/buyer on the platform
Complete KYC verification process
Submit produce details and quality certificates
Participate in online auctions and trading
Receive payments through integrated payment system

schemes.objective: To incentivize states to increase investment in agriculture and allied sectors while ensuring holistic development of agriculture by allowing states flexibility to choose their own agriculture development activities
benefits: Flexible funding for state-specific agriculture programs
Support for crop development, horticulture, animal husbandry
Infrastructure development for agriculture marketing
Promotion of organic farming and natural resource management
Technology adoption and mechanization support
Capacity building and training programs
Research and development initiatives support
eligibility_criteria: All states and Union Territories are eligible
State must have State Agricultural Plans (SAPs)
District Agricultural Plans (DAPs) preparation mandatory
States must spend minimum proportion for agriculture sector
Individual farmers engaged in agricultural activities
Valid land records required
Indian residency mandatory
how_to_apply: States submit proposals to central government
Individual farmers apply through state agriculture departments
Submit detailed project reports (DPRs)
Online applications through state portals
Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) for approved schemes

schemes.objective: To provide comprehensive digital geospatial platform integrating remote sensing data on crops, soil, weather, and water resources for enhanced decision-making in agriculture through data-driven insights
benefits: Real-time crop monitoring and yield estimation
Soil moisture and health monitoring
Weather-based advisories for farming decisions
Drought monitoring and early warning systems
Crop weather watch and harvest tracking
Field-parcel segmentation for targeted interventions
Comprehensive soil information system
Data-driven crop planning and management
eligibility_criteria: All farmers across India
Agriculture scientists and researchers
Government officials and policy makers
Agricultural institutions and universities
State agriculture departments
Anyone involved in agricultural activities
exclusions: No specific exclusions - open platform for agriculture stakeholders
how_to_apply: Access Krishi-DSS portal: https://krishi-dss.gov.in
Register with Aadhaar and mobile number
Select location/area of interest
Access various data layers and analytics
Download reports and advisories
Use mobile app for field-level access
whom_to_contact: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

metadata.data_source: Government of India Agriculture & Farmers Welfare Ministry
